metadata.title: SR sector 03
metadata.description: Storage-ring sector 03 of the control-assistant facility: straight 03 and its arc in beam order with every magnet, corrector and BPM of the records, the straight's own devices, the vacuum (ion pumps, gauges, gate valves), insertion devices, front-end shutters, absorber temperatures, scrapers and the tunnel environment, with their status and readbacks, and the orbit at the arc's BPMs as X and Y bars.
